page.overview:
Who is Wandering Minister of Inspection?

The is an attendant of the Jade Emperor.

When Sun Wukong rampaged in Heaven, the Jade Emperor sent the Wandering Minister of Inspection and the Immortal Master of Blessed Wings were sent to Thunderclap Monastery to seek help from the Tathagata Buddha.
